title: Blocked corridor; detour inside lease zone
note: Edge = the real supervisor (C1 SLM / C2 relay / C3 rules), kinematic mock robot, driven in-process. A persistent corridor obstacle forces a tactical decision; a detour exists inside the lease. The edge<->cloud link is degraded for the whole mission by an in-process FaultProxy (latency+jitter+loss), not tc. C1 and C3 decide the detour LOCALLY (link not on the decision path) and are fast; C2 must round-trip to the cloud per decision and stalls on the bad link. Completion time and decision latency are measured, not inferred. T4 owns a local cloud for the same reason as T2 (a managed AWS endpoint cannot be degraded like this); T1/T8 use the deployed C1/C2 endpoints.
